title: DECASTE: Unveiling Caste Stereotypes in Large Language Models through Multi-Dimensional Bias Analysis
reasoning: The paper evaluates caste-based bias, which is intrinsically linked to religious and spiritual traditions (the varna system). Specifically, it benchmarks model associations with religious rituals (e.g., Vedic Yajnas, temple pujas), dietary traditions (e.g., Sattvic diet), and roles derived from religious hierarchy.
